section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch3 — Indian Polity — Deep Practice 2
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) of Parliament primarily examines:

options.option_text: The CAG's audit reports on government expenditure

explanation: The PAC scrutinises CAG audit reports to ensure public money is spent as authorised by Parliament, chaired conventionally by an opposition member — a key financial accountability mechanism.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch3 — Indian Polity — Deep Practice 2
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Anti-Defection Law, which disqualifies a legislator for switching parties after election, was added to the Constitution by which Schedule?
explanation: The Tenth Schedule, inserted by the 52nd Amendment (1985), contains anti-defection provisions. The Eighth Schedule lists languages; the Ninth shields certain laws from review; the Seventh has the legislative lists.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch3 — Indian Polity — Deep Practice 2
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Governor of a state is appointed by the:

options.option_text: Chief Justice of the High Court

explanation: Under Article 155, the Governor is appointed by the President and holds office at the President's pleasure — an appointed, not elected, position.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch3 — Indian Polity — Deep Practice 2
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The highest law officer of the Government of India, who advises the government on legal matters, is the:
explanation: The Attorney General (Article 76) is the Government of India's chief legal advisor. The Chief Justice heads the judiciary; the Solicitor General assists the AG but ranks below.
